paragraphs: Zaza. Ben Zaza’s mother died; Rabban Gamliel eulogized her so they would know the court had not sanctified the month: Rosh Hashanah 25a. In Yuchasin, under chet, Rabbi Chiyya bar Zaza of Caesarea; requires examination (I did not find it).
